notes: Primary experimental paper (Carbon 2005, Max-Planck Stuttgart). Volumetric Sieverts H2 uptake from 2 bar to ~60-66 bar at 77 K and 298 K on ten carbon samples (activated carbons, porous templated carbons, SWCNTs, amorphous CNTs, Ros 1/Ros 3 CNT mixtures); some samples also measured gravimetrically (Cahn microbalance, 0.2-0.9 bar, 77 K). Fig. 2 axes: H2 Pressure [bar], weight % storage, curves labelled T=77K and T=298K. BET SSA for all ten samples in Table 1 (N2 at 77 K, multipoint BET). No retraction statement; no statement that the uptake values were published before.
